The name Alcine carries the meaning “Supplanter” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alcine usually hope their child will grow to embody supplanter and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: In Christian folklore, Alcine symbolizes the idea of renewal and succession. As a name associated with a bishop who succeeded another saint, it represents the passing of the spiritual mantle from one generation to the next and the belief that leadership and guidance can continue even in the face of change.
